title: Chinese Dried Glazed Chicken
description: This Chinese-inspired dish features crispy-skinned chicken glazed with a sweet and sticky sauce, made with a combination of soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breasts and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and brush the soy sauce mixture evenly over the top of each breast.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the glaze is caramelized.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
